zone.factionTypeHint: Match: the faction is taken from main object [index] (the zone clarifies where to look); FromList: a list of factions and/or differentFrom
zone.factionArgIndexHint: Whose faction to take: the list from the zone’s “Main objects” section; if “Zone” is set — from its list. In the file — the object index (faction.args[0])
zone.factionArgZoneHint: Optional: the zone whose “Main objects” to search the object in; without it — the current zone’s objects
zone.factionRestHint: Expressions like “differentFrom: 0 Spawn-A” are part of the faction list
zone.spawnOnlyHint: Only for type: Spawn; player color Player1–Player8
zone.placementHint: placement — the rule for placing the object in the zone
zone.placementArgsHint: placementArgs — Connection: [connection name]; Uniform/Center: [bool, −1..1, 0..4] (hypothesis: edge snapping/offset/side); NearZone: [zone]
zone.banPresetHint: buildingsBanSid — sid of the banned buildings list (1 file: Exodus)
zone.holdCityWinConHint: holdCityWinCon — the city takes part in the City Hold win condition
zone.isKeyObjectHint: isKeyObject — likely related to a win condition on key objects (1 file: Harmony)
zone.guardChanceHint: guardChance — 0–1; the probability that the object gets a guard
zone.moGuardWeeklyHint: guardWeeklyIncrement — 0.05–0.5; the fraction by which the guard grows each week
zone.removeGuardHint: removeGuardIfHasOwner — remove the guard if the object got an owner (always true in stock templates)
zone.initialUnitIncrementHint: initialUnitIncrement — starting increment of garrison units (1 file: Shamrock)
zone.enableWeeklyUnitIncrementHint: enableWeeklyUnitIncrement — enable the weekly garrison increment
zone.zoneBiomeHint: zoneBiome — biome of the zone surface
zone.contentBiomeHint: contentBiome — the zone’s content objects come from this biome
zone.metaObjectsBiomeHint: metaObjectsBiome — biome of the environment decor
zone.biomeZoneHint: Name of the zone whose biome to use
zone.biomeArgIndexHint: Whose biome to take: the list from the zone’s “Main objects” section; if “Zone” is set — from its list. In the file — the object index (args[0])
zone.biomeArgZoneHint: Optional: the zone whose “Main objects” to search the object in; without it — the current zone’s objects
zone.biomeRestHint: Expressions like “differentFrom: 0 Spawn-A” are part of the biome list
zone.reactionTitle: 6 reaction tier weights. Semantics unknown — experimental
zone.reactionHint: 6 reaction tier weights (0..120+). Semantics unknown — experimental.
zone.nameHint: Unique name within the variant; connections, biomes and references update automatically
zone.nameTakenError: The name “{{name}}” is already taken by another zone
zone.sizeHint: size — relative weight of the zone area (0.15–2)
zone.layoutHint: layout — a reference to one of the template’s zoneLayouts[] (“Template” panel → zoneLayouts). The name is an arbitrary sid; the parameters give it meaning: obstacles, lakes, elevation. The options show a summary of the layout parameters
zone.crossroadsHint: crossroadsPosition — a single number 0–1 (not a coordinate pair): the normalized position of the crossroads — the point where roads meet inside the zone. Hypothesis: 0 — at the zone center, 1 — at the edge; 0 or 0.5 in stock templates. Marked with the ✕ icon on the canvas
zone.guardedBudgetHint: guardedContentValue — absolute “value” of the zone’s guarded content
zone.guardedBudgetAreaHint: guardedContentValuePerArea — “value” of guarded content per zone area
zone.unguardedBudgetHint: unguardedContentValue — absolute “value” of the zone’s unguarded content
zone.unguardedBudgetAreaHint: unguardedContentValuePerArea — “value” of unguarded content per zone area
zone.resourcesBudgetHint: resourcesValue — absolute “value” of the zone’s resource content
zone.resourcesBudgetAreaHint: resourcesValuePerArea — “value” of resource content per zone area
zone.budgetsHint: Either the absolute value or PerArea is filled in — the generator uses one of the two.
zone.guardCutoffHint: guardCutoffValue — hypothesis: the minimum “value” below which an object is not placed with a guard (0–3500)
zone.guardMultiplierHint: guardMultiplier — 0.1–5; how many times the zone guard is strengthened (1.05/1.35/1.7 in the Jebus pair)
zone.guardRandomizationHint: guardRandomization — always 0.05 in stock templates (±5% of guard strength)
zone.guardWeeklyIncrementHint: guardWeeklyIncrement — 0.05–0.2; the fraction of the guard strength by which it grows each week
zone.diplomacyHint: diplomacyModifier — −0.5…−0.25, always negative; hypothesis: the chance of armies joining in the zone
zone.randomHireHint: External hire buildings random_hire_1–7 (tiers 1–7). Enabling the column writes an array of 7 values; disabling it removes the field from the template.
zone.randomHireLenWarn: {{field}}: the file has an array of {{n}} — normalized to 7 on edit
zone.holesHint: A hole is an “eaten” pickup slot or tile of an encounter. Active only with the master flag gameRules.encounterHoles=true (Anarchy in stock templates; in Maze the settings are dead). Fractions 0..1.
zone.affectedEncountersHint: affectedEncounters — the share (0..1) of the zone’s encounters that get a hole
zone.twoHoleEncountersLabel: Share of encounters with two holes
zone.twoHoleEncountersHint: twoHoleEncounters — the share (0..1) of encounters with two holes; whether it counts from all of the zone’s encounters or only the affected ones is not yet determined
zone.mandatoryContentHint: Group names from the “Template” panel → “Mandatory content”
zone.contentCountLimitsHint: Group names from the “Template” panel → “Count limits”
zone.groupRefMissingTitle: Group “{{name}}” not found in the template’s root list — check the name or create the group in the “Template” panel
zone.notesPlaceholder: Arbitrary text or markdown — just for you, not written to .rmg.json
zone.notesHint: The note is stored in the .editor.json sidecar file and restored when opening the file pair
